intent: Show a user's position within a fixed, ordered multi-step process (checkout, onboarding, setup wizard).
avoid_when: progress is a single continuous percentage rather than discrete named steps (use progress-indicators)
a11y_contract: wrapped in `<nav aria-label="Progress">` (overridable); only the current step is marked `aria-current="step"`; connector lines between steps are aria-hidden
requires_data: an ordered list of steps with label and status (complete/current/upcoming)
